title: Acoustic-phonon-driven spin-lattice relaxation of the hBN boron vacancy in the sub-THz regime
summary: The negatively charged boron vacancy center in hexagonal boron nitride is a premier candidate for quantum sensing, yet its performance is critically limited by longitudinal spin-lattice relaxation time ($T_1$). A microscopic understanding of spin relaxation in the high magnetic field regime remains elusive, as the relevant Zeeman transitions lie far below the optical phonon energies typically invoked to describe the relaxation process.
